verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a business financial platform, so 24/7 live support for urgent account issues is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers support channels, hours, or live agents. The items address APIs, cards, transfers, webhooks, the CLI and AI tooling, which are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
